answer.label: Not Morgan Freeman
answer.sourceLine: The Freeman credit is false. Snopes traced its circulation to a parody account called Tweets from God, whose disclaimer said it was not associated with the actor.

trail: Snopes’s full fact-check ↗ documents the dated parody-account post and disclaimer and states that Freeman neither originated nor repeated the words.

Bruce Almighty’s cast record ↗ confirms Freeman played God; this explains the impersonation device, not authorship.

author.bio: The located evidence identifies a parody account that circulated the remark, not its original composer. The false celebrity connection arose through Morgan Freeman’s portrayal of God in Bruce Almighty and an account disclaimer explaining that it was not associated with the actor. Freeman is an actor, not the documented source of this post.

context.heading: Why it mattered
lead: The fake credit depended on a familiar screen role: Freeman plays God in Bruce Almighty. A parody feed could borrow that association while explicitly disclaiming a connection to the actor, but subsequent quotation images removed that distinction.
